subject: Data Development at Verana Qdata | Working with FlatIron & TargetRWE
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

Saw your recent focus on data development & quality as you integrate more complex clinical data, thought I'd reach out.

I've recently been working with Flatiron Health and TargetRWE who were in a similar position as they looked to streamline data curation and annotation workflows to enhance regulatory compliance and efficiency in handling unstructured data (EHRs, PDFs, DICOM etc). Our platform's integration and automation capabilities improved interoperability, offering a future-proof solution for managing multimodal data across their operations.

Would be keen to trade notes and get your thoughts on what we're building - open to a 30-minute chat this or next week?

subject: ADAS Coffee @CVPR [YEAR]?
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you're attending CVPR this year so I wanted to reach out. We've been
working on projects w/ Woven by Toyota, Wayve, Mobileye, etc. on developing
similar ADAS models, thought it's worth connecting.

A bit of context on Encord - we help over 200 AI teams improve data quality
for model development. We focus on consolidating data curation, annotation
and model evaluation with the goals of efficiency gains for training
dataset preparation & model iterations.

Would you be open to a coffee & exchange perspectives? We'll be in
Nashville Friday (6/13) to Sunday (6/15). If virtual is easier, happy to
find a time that suits you!

subject: CVPR Private Happy Hour Invite
text:
Hi [NAME],

I thought there's a good chance you'll be at CVPR this year - and if so,
I'd love to introduce myself in person. I lead Encord's work with
healthcare and video surveillance like Teton, Flock Safety, Voxel AI and
Verkada etc. We're helping their AI teams accelerate model development with
high-quality training data and improved pipeline automation, critical for
new use cases/products i.e. predictive risk modelling, object detection and
other edge cases.

We're hosting a relaxed happy hour for AI/ML leaders on the Friday evening
(June 13th) in Nashville, co-hosted with Lambda and Captions. Let me know
if you'd like to join and I'll send over the private guestlist details.

If you're not familiar, Encord is a Series B ML data platform ($50M
raised), unifying data curation, annotation, and model evaluation for
advanced CV and multimodal teams.

Happy to meet for a coffee if easier, or let me know if you'd like to book
a quick demo of the platform as we'll be on booth #1123.

text:
